QuestInfo.name: [Sizzling Santa] The Contest Ends
QuestInfo.0: Everyone worked hard on the Grand Santa Contest, and it has finally come to an end.\r\nWho will be the winning Santa? Go find out with your helpers.
QuestInfo.2: You won the Best Effort category of the Grand Santa Contest!\r\nYou owe your victory to how well everyone came together as a team.
